title: Declaration of which staged files and which variables and columns inside them are reserved and unopened
why_this_exists: The intake manifest classified the staged datasets in prose. Prose is not a record: it does not pin the files by checksum, it does not say which variable inside a file is the holdout, and it cannot be checked. This contract names every reserved file and every reserved variable or column, and the manifest built from it records the structure and the checksum of each one before any value is opened. A reservation is worth exactly as much as the record of what was reserved.

reservation_rule.reserved: A reserved name may not be read, printed, plotted, summarised or fitted until a preregistered contract names the file, the variable, the metric and the limit, and that contract is committed before the values are opened.
reservation_rule.unreserved: An unreserved name carries no observation. Join keys, cell-type labels and cross-dataset mapping columns are unreserved because a holdout is spent by seeing the measurement, not by seeing which cells were measured. Reading them is what makes it possible to establish whether a join is even feasible before spending anything.
reservation_rule.structure_is_not_a_value: File names, byte counts, checksums, variable names, array shapes, column headers, row counts and archive listings are metadata and were read. No numeric observation was decoded.
reservation_rule.analysis_code_is_not_a_value: The MATLAB analysis scripts shipped with the Rozenfeld repository were read in full. They are code: they name the axis labels, the stimulation conditions and the statistics the authors ran, which is what established that the evoked recordings are compound rather than unitary. Reading them decodes no observation, and the determination it produced is recorded in ADR-2026-012.
reservation_rule.what_this_does_not_protect_against: A variable name can be informative on its own. Knowing that paired-pulse ratios exist at five intervals says recovery kinetics were measured, which the paper's abstract already says. The rule protects the values, which is what a holdout is.

claim_boundary: A declaration and a record. It scores nothing, opens nothing, and awards no tier.

known_duplications_audited_2026_09_10.why_this_exists: A holdout was preregistered, committed, opened and scored against Figure 3J's wild-type paired-pulse arrays on 2026-09-10 before anyone noticed that they are bit-identical to Figure 3D's, which had already been spent. The published legends gave both the same animal counts and the coincidence was noticed and not acted on. This block is the audit that should have preceded that run, extended to every file in Figure 3 that shares a variable name with another.
known_duplications_audited_2026_09_10.how_it_was_measured: flysim.reservations.stored_element_digests, which digests each variable's stored element bytes without decompressing or decoding any payload. Equal stored bytes prove equal data. Unequal stored bytes do not prove unequal data, so a clean result here is a screen and not a certificate of independence.
known_duplications_audited_2026_09_10.the_pattern: The day-1 wild-type controls are reused copies of the 2-to-4-day wild-type controls. The day-0 wild-type controls are genuinely separate recordings. This holds in both places it can be checked: the paired-pulse arrays and the absolute amplitude arrays. It is not misconduct -- the authors compared each perturbation cohort against a wild-type reference and reused that reference for the day-1 comparison -- but it means the repository ships fewer independent wild-type cohorts than its figure count suggests.

known_duplications_audited_2026_09_10.what_still_has_to_be_done_by_hand: Comparing the published animal counts. The digest audit catches reuse of the same stored bytes; it cannot catch two files holding the same animals recorded twice, or a legend that misdescribes a cohort. Every train array in Fig3E_and_F reports 18 animals at every frequency, which the digests confirm are 24 distinct arrays but which should still be reconciled against the paper's stated n before those arrays are scored.

the_corpus_holds_no_orn_to_pn_train_ampl: There is no unspent wild-type ORN-to-PN amplitude holdout in this corpus, and there never was one. Rozenfeld and colleagues' repository offers, for this synapse: per-animal mean evoked amplitude at 1 Hz in Fig3B, Fig3G and Fig3I, of which Fig3B and Fig3I are bit-identical; paired-pulse ratios in Fig3D, Fig3H and Fig3J, of which Fig3D and Fig3J are bit-identical; miniature EPSC amplitude and frequency in Fig5B; and Bruchpilot puncta in Fig5D. No train amplitude series exists anywhere in it. So the resource recovery constant cannot be measured from this corpus by anyone, the plan to settle it with the trains was built on a mis-read header, and the candidates' pinned constant remains unmeasurable rather than merely unmeasured.

whole_repository_structure_audit_2026_09.why_it_was_run: The claim that no ORN-to-PN train amplitude series exists in this corpus was made after examining one figure directory and asserted for the whole repository. That is the same shape as the six errors this session already recorded, so it was checked rather than left standing.
whole_repository_structure_audit_2026_09.method: flysim.reservations.read_mat_structure over every MAT file in the repository. Variable names, classes and array shapes only; the reader is structurally incapable of returning a value and no payload was decoded. Structure is not a value under the reservation rule, so the audit spent nothing.
whole_repository_structure_audit_2026_09.the_claim_as_it_now_stands: SUPERSEDED. The audit's finding that the only per-pulse train arrays are Fig3E_and_F's latencies and the 32-column arrays of Fig3B, Fig3G and Fig3I was correct; the conclusion drawn from it was not. Those 32-column arrays ARE per-pulse amplitude trajectories over a 1 Hz train, which is exactly what the corpus was said to lack. See correction_the_corpus_does_hold_train_amplitude_series.
whole_repository_structure_audit_2026_09.the_qualification_that_must_travel_with_: Five files could not be read and their contents are unknown. The claim is therefore about 61 of 66 files and not about the repository. Four of the five sit in figures about odour responses or behaviour, where an evoked-amplitude train series would be out of place, but 'would be out of place' is an inference of exactly the kind this session has been punished for six times, so it is recorded as an open question rather than as a conclusion.

the_five_unreadable_files.Figure 1/Fig1D.mat: MATLAB v7.3, an HDF5 container the header-only reader deliberately does not parse
the_five_unreadable_files.Figure 8/Fig8B.mat: v5 container, but the reader fails with a malformed dimensions subelement

whole_repository_structure_audit_2026_09.a_defect_in_the_project_reader_not_in_th: Fig8B and FigS13 are version 5 containers that this project's structure reader cannot parse, failing on the dimensions subelement. That is a limitation of flysim.reservations.read_mat_structure -- most likely a variable class it does not handle, such as a cell array or a struct -- and not a property of the files. It is recorded here rather than fixed, because fixing it is not needed for any current contract and because an unrecorded reader limitation is how a corpus gets described from the files that happened to open.
whole_repository_structure_audit_2026_09.what_the_audit_also_settled: Fig3G's wild-type 1 Hz array has 20 animals against Fig3B's and Fig3I's 17, which matches the published legends for the day-0 and 2-to-4-day cohorts and is consistent with the recorded finding that Fig3B and Fig3I are bit-identical while Fig3G is a separate day-0 recording.

correction_the_corpus_does_hold_train_am.the_claim_withdrawn: That no ORN-to-PN train amplitude series exists anywhere in the Rozenfeld corpus, and that advancing this synapse therefore required a different dataset.
correction_the_corpus_does_hold_train_am.what_is_actually_there: Fig3B, Fig3G and Fig3I each hold a 32-column array of per-pulse evoked amplitudes over a 1 Hz train. The methods say so: 'To measure eEPSC amplitudes and kinetics, 32 eEPSCs were evoked at 1 Hz and averaged.' The authors averaged the 32 columns to one number per animal for their figure; the columns themselves are the trajectory. Fig3B's wild-type array is negative-going, seventeen animals finite at every one of the 32 columns, and it depresses from 1.000 to a plateau near 0.70.

the_measured_trajectory.cohort: wild type, 2 to 4 days post eclosion, 17 animals

correction_the_corpus_does_hold_train_am.why_this_matters_more_than_the_other_six: It is the claim that closed the goal off. Having decided the corpus held no train amplitude series, the recorded conclusion was that the recovery constant is unmeasurable here and that progress needed procurement. Both were wrong. The measured 1 Hz steady state is 0.703, which sits BETWEEN the refuted predecessor's 0.904 and the two candidates' 0.341 and 0.402 -- so all three registered accounts are wrong, in opposite directions, and the data to constrain the parameter that separates them was in the corpus the whole time.
correction_the_corpus_does_hold_train_am.how_it_was_missed: Fig3B was classified on 2026-09-09 as 'per-animal evoked-EPSC amplitude at 1 Hz in absolute picoamps; reserved and not scored, because ND-04 carries no absolute conductance scale for this synapse'. That is true of the absolute amplitude and irrelevant to the trajectory: normalising the 32 columns to the first pulse needs no conductance scale at all. A file was dismissed on a property of one statistic derivable from it, without asking what else it contained.

what_is_now_spent_and_what_is_not.Fig3B_wild_type: SPENT on 2026-09-10, opened while characterising the mis-described latency arrays. Legitimate corpus-correction work, and it spent a holdout. It becomes a fitting set.
what_is_now_spent_and_what_is_not.Fig3I_wild_type: bit-identical to Fig3B, therefore also spent and carrying no new animals
what_is_now_spent_and_what_is_not.Fig3G_wild_type: UNSPENT. Day 0, twenty animals, thirty-two pulses at 1 Hz. Never decoded: the audits that touched it read structures and stored-byte digests only. It is a genuine unspent train-amplitude holdout.

correction_the_corpus_does_hold_train_am.the_seventh_instance: This is the seventh claim this session that was inferred rather than measured, and the fourth about what a file contains. The pattern is now: a file was dismissed on one property, a join size read off a row count, a preparation read off a plotting label, a cohort's independence read off a legend, a model's train behaviour read off one term, and which sites matter read off which sites survive. Every one flattered the project except this one, which did the opposite -- it made the goal look unreachable when it was not.
